context: Step 5 of the owner-approved Option 1 corpus consolidation plan (2026-11-24). Must wait until after the core release shipping Step 3 and the corresponding benchbox-site release docs (Step 4) are live.
description:
## Problem
Once the next core release ships `benchbox submit` targeting `develop` (Step 3) and `benchbox-site` releases the matching docs from `next` to `main` (Step 4), the entire `develop -> published-results` mirror, drift-detection, and slim-branch fallback stack is pure maintenance overhead.

## Change
1. Remove the mirror and drift machinery from `develop`:
   - `.github/workflows/sync-results-data-to-published.yml`
   - `.github/workflows/submission-validator-drift-check.yml` and `scripts/check_submission_validator_sync.py`
   - `.github/workflows/corpus-drift-check.yml` and `scripts/corpus_drift.py`
   - The `Submission validator stays in sync` step and `published-results` rule in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`
   - The `origin/published-results` fetch/recut in `.github/workflows/seed-corpus.yml` (point ledger recut at `develop`)
   - The `published-results` drift/privacy checks in `.github/workflows/nightly-v2.yml` (keep corpus privacy scan running on `develop:results-data/`)
   - Slim-branch-only stdlib file-loader fallbacks where no caller remains, plus obsolete mirror/drift unit tests and fixtures (~30 files; verify every removed test has no remaining live contract).
2. Refresh `quality/docs-reference-inventory.json` and `_project/scripts/project_references_baseline.txt` as needed.
3. Update `README.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md` on `published-results` to state the branch is frozen read-only and direct 0.5.x users to `develop` (plus `https://benchbox.dev/docs/contributing-results.html`). Ask the owner to lock/freeze the `published-results` branch via GitHub branch protection/ruleset (owner-only action). Never delete `published-results`.
4. Drop superseded tracker items (`mirror-validator-submission-guard-standard-scales-20261122`, and check `crr-a5-published-results-mirror` / PR #4481) with owner confirmation.

## Decision gates
- HARD STOP before starting: confirm a tagged core release containing Step 3 (`submit-cli-target-develop-20261124`) is published AND `benchbox-site` `main` includes the Step 4 docs. Do not retire or freeze `published-results` while released CLI users are still sent there.
- NEVER delete the `published-results` branch: its Git history holds accepted bundles and 0.5.x links point at it.
- Owner-only action: applying a read-only GitHub branch ruleset/protection on `published-results` requires owner settings authority — stop and hand the exact ruleset step to the owner.
- Before deleting any privacy scan in `nightly-v2.yml` or `corpus-drift-check.yml`, verify an equivalent privacy scan runs on `develop:results-data/` (never reduce corpus privacy coverage).

## Verification rubric
- Pass: `rg 'sync-results-data-to-published|submission-validator-drift-check|corpus-drift-check' .github/ scripts/ tests/` returns 0 live references; `develop:results-data/` privacy scanning still runs in CI/nightly; `make pr-preflight` and hosted `review-gate` pass; `published-results` tip displays the frozen pointer README and is protected read-only; superseded items dropped.
- Fail: `published-results` is deleted, retirement lands before the Step 3 release + Step 4 site release, or corpus privacy scanning is lost.

## Guardrails
Work in a linked worktree (`make worktree-create`), never the primary clone. Stage named paths only; commit with pinned human Git identity and no agent attribution. No explanatory comments or docstrings in first-party Python (`make comment-policy-check`). Heavy work only via `make pr-preflight` / `make heavy-run`; never bypass `~/.benchbox/test.lock`. Soundness paths touched (`.github/workflows/`, `scripts/publication/`): resolve every `benchbox-review` thread and arm only on a green review of the current head.
